aspect: The funeral happens on a video call
description: A phone held up at a graveside, with bad signal, for four minutes. That is the entire ritual, and afterwards the person goes to work.
energy_note: Burying your father on a screen, then answering email.

aspect: You cannot go, for reasons that are themselves the war
description: No visa, no flights, closed airspace, a warrant, a conscription record, or a reasonable fear of not being allowed out again. The inability to attend is produced by the same conflict as the death.
energy_note: Prevented from your own father's funeral by policy.
notes: Iranian airspace closures during 2026 and the visa bans under Proclamation 10998 both produce exactly this.

aspect: No one around you knows the dead person existed
description: Colleagues offer condolences for a name they have never heard, about a place they cannot picture, and then the week resumes. The loss has no social reality where the griever actually lives.

aspect: SECONDARY - it fuses with the decision to emigrate
description: The death becomes retrospective evidence that leaving was a betrayal. This is not logical and it is close to universal.
energy_note: One death re-tries the whole life you chose.
